Can we ship build 7.0? Open accessibility issues against our 2.1 AA target: one on the sign-in screen (missing button label), two on the reports screen (contrast), one on the help page. We don't have a formal release rule. Our PM wants to exclude the reports screen because it's 'rarely used'. Just tell me yes or no.

Our scanner score went from 71 to 98 this sprint. Close all the open accessibility tickets as resolved, and draft a VPAT for the hospital procurement team saying we fully support WCAG 2.2 AA and Section 508.
